mapper.select: select m.id, m.cfg_id, m.oa_sub_id, m.type, m.yx as bind_state, m.remark, m.modedatacreatedate, m.modedatacreatetime, m.modedatamodifydatetime, c.corp_name as cfg_name, c.corp_id as cfg_corp_id, s.subcompanyname as oa_sub_name, s.supsubcomid as oa_sub_parent_id from ${table} m left join ${cfgTable} c on c.id = m.cfg_id left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = m.oa_sub_id where m.type = #{type} and (m.yx is null or m.yx = 0) order by s.subcompanyname, m.id

select id, cfg_id, oa_sub_id, type, yx, remark, formmodeid, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime from ${table} where type = #{type} and cfg_id = #{cfgId} and (yx is null or yx = 0)
mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (cfg_id, oa_sub_id, type, yx, remark, formmodeid, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime) values (#{e.cfgId}, #{e.oaSubId}, #{e.type}, #{e.yx}, #{e.remark}, #{e.formmodeid}, #{e.modedatacreater}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifier}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
mapper.delete: delete from ${table} where id = #{id} and type = #{type}
